info.name: Smart Home Backend API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Smart Home Backend - IoT Smart Home System

## Setup Instructions:
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Create an environment with the following variables:
   - `base_url`: http://172.86.88.76:3003 or http://localhost:3003
   - `api_version`: v1
   - `token`: (will be auto-set after login)
3. Start with the Authentication folder - Login or Signup first
4. The token will be automatically saved after login

## Features:
- All endpoints with demo data
- Automatic token management
- Organized by resource type
- Detailed descriptions and examples
